integrity.finite_verification: Dependency-free exact-rational checker verified 279 edge columns and 14064 bypass paths from five distinct parameter constructions.
integrity.proof_method: Direct combinatorial counts and exact Poisson potential yield uniform length-five bypass decomposition; exact endpoint norms and phase boundary follow.

scientific_limitations: Only existing simple Steiner 2-(v,k,1) designs with 2 <= k < v, unweighted point-block incidence graphs, and real canonical orthogonal cut/cycle projections.
No optimality among all projections or intermediate-exponent norms, weighted incidence graphs, or arbitrary lambda>1 designs is asserted.
The numerical verification treats five finite design instances only; the all-design result follows from the displayed exact Laplacian argument.
Equivalent bibliographic formulations not uncovered in the completed searches remain a residual uncertainty.
title: Equal-length electrical bypasses and exact endpoint Hodge norms for Steiner pair designs
